reviews.text: I have been taking my Shih Tzu Santana here for 5 years. They always do a great job. She has had many haircuts over the years. She is not an easy dog to groom, and when I have brought her to other groomers they wouldn’t take her because she is not outwardly friendly, she’s very scared in these situations. Vlada grooming took her no problem and handle her with care. There are groomers closer to my house but I will continue to take her here.
They did an excellent job for my Poodle Pomeranian mix.
Awesome customer service, the owner is very caring and did an amazing job!

This grooming salon is truly exceptional. The service, care, and attention to detail are unmatched. My dog's haircut came out perfect, clean, stylish, and exactly what | asked for. She is professional in every sense of the word and treats every dog with patience and genuine love. I drive  from NJ just to come here because there is simply nobody like her. Worth the trip every single time!

I'm super happy w my visit here. I just recently adopted a 2 yr old cavachon who was in horrible condition hair wise - super matted and out grown. Not only was I able to make a last minute weekend appt w them but they were super reasonable & nice, called me once she was done & my furbaby looks sooo good!! It was SO much better than I anticipated, I'm so so happy 🐶
Thank you!!

*Update*
Just picked Brookie up from here again (11/11/23) & am ecstatic! She looks amazing, thank you!!! She smells great too and is so soft. Another last min request on a Saturday morning and they took her within 2 hrs & she was done in less than 3, absolutely no complaints and would recommend here for dog grooming 100%. I asked for my version of the hygenic cut for cavachons & she did EXACTLY what I asked/pictured.

10/5/24

I let my poor Brookie become too overgrown again procrastinating bringing her in for a grooming bc its not her fav thing and I hate making her upset (dog mom problems lol). But she'd become matted and I had to bring her in for a grooming asap. I'm super busy even on weekends but its more possible so i called Vlada last min yesterday (10/5), a Sat morning and although she was busy she allowed me to bring Brookie in right away and groomed her!! Less than 2 hrs Brookie was back home, nice and groomed and super happy it wasnt a long process. When they brought her out to me she was jumping and happy and they even painted her nails 💅 as an added touch. Thank you again for taking us last min, idk what we'd do without you!! See you next time! 🐾

12/15 - Another great grooming for my Boogie! They even gave her a little clip 🥰 less than 2 hrs she was done and back w me, and shes always so happy after. Will be back in 2 wks! I've been coming 2× a month to prevent matting bc I like keeping her long and fluffy lol. The pic from today is the one of her w her lambchop sitting on the xmas matt.

**UPDATE 1/4/26**
Just had another great  hygenic cut/bath/blow out. We've been coming here for years now & I'm never disappointed in fact I'm often pleasantly surprised, fair prices, super accommodating, easy to book & its never an all day thing for your dog they're pretty quick but always great quality. My dog has sensitive skin and allergies and shes had no reactions. We come 2× a month (every other Sunday).
Exceptional quality of grooming! I bringing my dogs here for more than 17 years! Excellent work always!

Highly Recommended Groomer

I am very pleased with the services provided by Vlada Grooming. Vlada was professional, patient, and attentive while taking care of both my cats and my dog. She handled each pet with great care and confidence, which made the experience stress-free.

The quality of the grooming was excellent, and my pets were clean, comfortable, and well cared for. It is clear that Vlada is experienced and truly dedicated to her work.

I would highly recommend Vlada Grooming to anyone looking for a trustworthy and professional groomer.

I brought my Yorkie in a few weeks ago and she looked absolutely amazing when she was done, we’ve received so many compliments! The staff was incredibly friendly and welcoming, and you can really tell how much they care about the dogs. I was beyond happy with the results and will definitely be coming back. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a fantastic groomer.

Excellent service, A+. The owner is a huge animal lover, she treats everyone’s pets as her own. Have been coming here for years and the staff is incredibly friendly and well trained. Great prices! Thank you for your wonderful service.

Vlada did an amazing job grooming my pets! She was fantastic with my German Shepherd and did a beautiful lion cut on my cat — it came out perfect. You can really tell she’s patient, skilled, and truly cares about the animals she works with. Both of my pets looked great and were comfortable throughout the process. I highly recommend Vlada to anyone looking for a professional and trustworthy groomer! 🐶🐱

I have been bringing my 2 dogs here for years. I come all the way from Staten Island to bring them here because this is the only place they are comfortable getting groomed. They do a great job and I have never had any issues. It is a friendly atmosphere and they are always very open and honest.
Dog came back with injury on leg, I had to stop the blood with peroxide because it just wasn't stopping. 0 stars if you care about your pets avoid at all costs.
ANNA‼️‼️ you’re great. She did an awesome job appointment is quick and easy nice job I am obsessed there was no problems.
